title: DockedReceipt JSON body (dockedReceipt)
description: Generated by scripts/docked-receipt-fixtures.js from eotha.rtse.v1.DockedReceipt; do not edit by hand. The shape of the `dockedReceipt` object a client relays to the meta-service. Every DockedReceipt field is required, the V3 catalog (outfittingStock, stockedQualityMask, artisanMaxTier) included: the signature covers it, so a body without it can never verify. Rules JSON Schema cannot express: outfittingStock is strictly ascending by componentType, and bit 0 of stockedQualityMask is clear.

pilotId.description: UTF-8 string, the JWT sub of the session; never empty

dockedEntityId.description: the 16 bytes as a lowercase hyphenated UUID string (8-4-4-4-12 hex), not base64

systemH3.description: H3 resolution 8 cell, 15 lowercase hex characters

dockedAtMs.description: JSON number (not a string), Unix ms

issuedAtMs.description: JSON number (not a string), Unix ms

nonce.description: the 16 bytes as standard padded base64 (24 characters)

signature.description: the 64-byte Ed25519 signature as standard padded base64 (88 characters)

controllingFactionId.description: faction key, or "" for an independent system; always present, even when ""

outfittingStock.description: array in the order the engine signed it (strictly ascending componentType); always present, [] when the dock stocks nothing

stockedQualityMask.description: JSON number, bit n set for QualityGrade n; bit 0 never set; always present, 0 when nothing is stocked

artisanMaxTier.description: JSON number; 0 means Artisan work has no cap of its own; always present

componentType.description: the ComponentType enum NUMBER (e.g. 1 for COMPONENT_TYPE_HULL), never its name; never 0 (UNSPECIFIED)
